18010000.name: Onslaught
18010000.desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and restores 100 MP.

18040000.name: Incandescent Blow
18040000.desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m. 2 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: Deals up to 12% more damage when less targets are hit
-200 enemy Accuracy for 3s on landing Bursting Blow
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as Multi-Hit

18100000.name: Dark Crush
18100000.desc: Deals damage to a target within 20m. 5 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: Deals extra damage on attacking a target afflicted with Impact-type status

18290000.name: Spinning Strike
18290000.desc: Selects a target within 20m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies nearby. Increases the caster's Critical Damage Boost by 15% for 30s on hit. Stacks up to 2 times. [Dark Crush] becomes available for 2s on skill use. 15 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: Up to +20% damage when less targets hit
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

18060000.name: Impactful Crush
18060000.desc: Deals damage to a target within 20m. Has a 60% chance to inflict Stun for 3s. 100% chance to inflict Stun on NPC targets. [Dark Crush] becomes available for 2s on skill use. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

18300000.name: Gust Rampage
18300000.desc: Deals damage to a target afflicted with Stagger within 4m.

18090000.name: Rushing Smash
18090000.desc: Rushes at a target within 20m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies and restores 100 MP. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: Changes to Charge Skill, dealing up to 200% more damage
50% chance to trigger [Heat Wave Blow] on hit
Resets cooldown on defeating an enemy
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as Multi-Hit

18210000.name: Tremor Crush
18210000.desc: Move to a target within 10m and deal damage with a 50% chance to inflict Stun for 3s after using [Dodge] or while flying. 100% chance to inflict Stun on NPC targets. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

18120000.name: Recuperation
18120000.desc: Restores 183-201 HP and removes 1 debuff(s) for the caster and party members within 40m. Restores HP every 2s for 8s.

specs.txt: +1 consecutive use and Heal over Time can stack up to 2 times

18160000.name: Sprint Mantra
18160000.desc: Increases Move Speed by 10.5% and grants a 15% chance to restore 127-140 HP on landing an attack to the caster and nearby party members. Healing Cooldown: 1s

specs.txt: +50% amount restored when HP is 50% or less

18190000.name: Undefeated Mantra
18190000.desc: Increases PvE Damage Boost and PvE Damage Tolerance by 10.5% and PvP Damage Boost and PvP Damage Tolerance by 5.25% for the caster and nearby party members. Does not stack with the Damage Boost effect from the Cleric skill [Light of Protection]; only the higher-level skill effect applies. If both skills are the same level, Undefeated Mantra takes precedence.

18250000.name: Power of the Storm
18250000.desc: Increases Combat Speed by 20% and reduces skill cooldowns by 20% for 10s. Increases Combat Speed by 20% and reduces skill cooldowns by 10% for party members within 40m. Cannot receive effect of [Power of the Storm] if Cleric skill [Earth's Blessing] effect is active.

specs.txt: +20% Caster Attack and +10% party member Attack

18330000.name: Marchutan's Wrath
18330000.desc: Selects a target within 20m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m. [Dark Crush] becomes available for 3s on skill use.

specs.txt: Up to +20% damage when less targets hit

18130000.name: Fracturing Blow
18130000.desc: Rushes to a target within 20m and deals damage and reduces their Defense by 30% for 5s. Increases damage by 20% to targets afflicted with an Impact-type status. 20 Stagger Gauge Damage

18170000.name: Healing Touch
18170000.desc: Restores 927-1020 HP for the caster and party members within 40m.

specs.txt: +20% amount healed when HP is 50% or less

18750000.name: Attack Preparation
18750000.desc: Increases the caster's PvE Damage Boost by 5.5%, PvP Damage Boost by 2.75%, Defense by 2%, and Accuracy by 100.

18800000.name: Wind's Promise
18800000.desc: Increases the caster's Critical Damage Boost by 5.7% and has a 50% chance to deal extra damage to the target on landing a Critical Hit. Extra Damage Cooldown: 1s

18760000.name: Impact Hit
18760000.desc: Increases the caster's Impact-type Chance by 11.2% and Double Chance by 0.3%.

18730000.name: Protection Circle
18730000.desc: Grants a Protection Circle that lasts for 5s on landing an attack. Removes the Protection Circle at 10 stacks and grants Divine Barrier to the caster and party members, which blocks damage equaling 3.1% of Max HP for 10s. The Divine Barrier refreshes upon reaching 10 stacks of Protection Circle while Divine Barrier is active. Grants a Noble Protective Shield for 5s that blocks 21% damage when the caster's HP drops below 50%. Protection Circle Cooldown: 0.5s Noble Protective Shield Cooldown: 60s

18080000.name: Wave Blow
18080000.desc: Deals damage to a target afflicted with Stun within 4m and inflicts Knockdown for 3s. Has a 7% chance to trigger on attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity, changing the skill motion. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: -15% target's PvE Damage Boost and -7.5% PvP Damage Boost for 10s

18150000.name: Heat Wave Blow
18150000.desc: Selects a target within 4m and deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m with a 40% chance to inflict Seal for 3s on Block. 100% chance to inflict Seal on NPC targets. 10 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.txt: Up to +20% damage when more targets hit
Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as Multi-Hit
25% chance to reset [Heat Wave Blow] cooldown on Block
